excavation_context.character_description: An adult female grad student working as a museum preparator, long black hair, Asian ethnicity. Wears a yellow tee shirt with a unicorn image worn UNDER a white lab coat, yellow skirt and white sneakers.
excavation_context.stage: Scribing Dense Matrix Away from a Spiked Back Plate

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_6 sits at her lab workbench under focused task lighting, guiding a thin pneumatic air-scribe tool across a block of dense grayish-green mudstone matrix. The fine sedimentary layers flake away neatly, slowly revealing the small spiked dermal plates and spine from the back of a Huayangosaurus. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
